items.title: 22.6.2 Phenols mein aromatic ring ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of the ring of phenol (PDF 96-97).

blocks.text: Phenol ke -OH group ka oxygen ring mein electron density deta hai: is ka aik lone pair ring ke pi nizam se mil kar delocalised hota hai. Izafi electron density ring ko electrophilic hamle ke liye zyada khula (activated) banati hai, aur -OH group aane wale electrophiles ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai.

Phenol ki nitration kamre ke darja hararat par halke nitric acid se hoti hai, 2-nitrophenol aur 4-nitrophenol ka mixture banta hai: C6H5OH + HNO3 -> HOC6H4NO2 + H2O. Garhe nitric acid se product 2,4,6-trinitrophenol hai: C6H5OH + 3HNO3 -> C6H2(NO2)3OH + 3H2O. Is ke muqable mein benzene ko garhe nitric aur sulphuric acids ka mixture 25 se 60 C tak garam chahiye; phenol zyada reactive hone se narm halaat chahta hai.

Phenol kamre ke darja hararat par bromine water se react karta hai: narangi bromine mehlool ka rang urata aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safaid precipitate banata hai: C6H5OH + 3Br2 -> C6H2Br3OH + 3HBr. Benzene ki bromination sirf khalis bromine (mehlool nahi) aur khushk AlBr3 catalyst se hoti hai; phenol bromine water se baghair catalyst aasani se react karta hai.

1-naphthol mein naphthalene ki position 1 par hydroxyl group hai. Phenol ki tarah -OH group electrons deta aur naphthalene ring ko electrophilic substitution ke liye fa'aal karta hai, electrophiles ko positions 2 aur/ya 4 par bhejta hai; positions 9 aur 10 par substitution nahi ho sakti kyunke un par hydrogen nahi. Ethanoic acid mein bromine ke saath 1-naphthol 2-bromo-1-naphthol aur 4-bromo-1-naphthol deta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: phenol halke HNO3 ke saath kamre ke darja hararat par 2-nitrophenol + 4-nitrophenol; garhe HNO3 se 2,4,6-trinitrophenol. Beech: phenol + 3Br2(aq), narangi, se 2,4,6-tribromophenol, safaid precipitate, + 3HBr; benzene ko khalis bromine aur AlBr3 chahiye. Neeche: 1-naphthol, ethanoic acid mein Br2 ke saath, 2-bromo-1-naphthol + 4-bromo-1-naphthol.
blocks.caption: Phenol aur 1-naphthol ki nitration aur bromination (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kyunke -OH group ring ko electrons deta hai, phenol aise halke reagents se react karta hai jo benzene ko chhoote bhi nahi, aur naye groups -OH ke saath wali aur saamne wali positions par jate hain. 1-naphthol bhi isi tarah, positions 2 aur 4 par, react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Phenol ka bromine water se reaction phenol ki pehchan ke liye use hota hai. Kya dikhta hai, aur product ka systematic naam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Narangi bromine water ka rang ur jata aur safaid precipitate banta hai: 2,4,6-tribromophenol.

blocks.prompt: Kaun aasani se nitrate hota hai, benzene ya phenol, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Phenol: is ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hota, electron density barhti aur ring NO2+ jaise electrophiles ko zyada kheenchta; kamre ke darja hararat par halka nitric acid kaafi hai.
C10H7OH + HNO3 -> HOC10H6NO2 + H2O, jis se 2-nitro-1-naphthol aur 4-nitro-1-naphthol bante hain (is ki bromination ki tarah).

items: -OH group ring ko fa'aal karta aur 2, 4 aur 6 par bhejta.
Bromine water: safaid 2,4,6-tribromophenol (phenol ka test); 1-naphthol 2 aur 4 par.
